# HockeyStack

> HockeyStack is an AI-powered B2B Revenue Data Platform that unifies marketing, sales, and product data through intelligent agents and GTM automation.

HockeyStack provides a suite of AI agents powered by its proprietary NexLM model to automate revenue operations, deal management, and sales enablement. The platform enables teams to leverage multi-touch attribution, account intelligence, and predictive analytics to optimize go-to-market strategies.

## Key Topics

- AI Agents
- GTM Automation
- Multi-Touch Attribution
- Deal Management
- Account Intelligence
- Sales Enablement
- Pipeline Intelligence
- Revenue Operations
- Workflow Automation
- NexLM
- Account Scoring
- Sales Automation
- Customer Success
- Competitive Intelligence
- Forecast Accuracy

## Platform Overview

- [HockeyStack | AI Agents for Revenue](https://www.hockeystack.com): HockeyStack AI-powered B2B Revenue Data Platform unifying marketing, sales, and product data
- [HockeyStack Agents](https://www.hockeystack.com/agents): HockeyStack AI Agents for sales enablement, deal management, and revenue operations
- [HockeyStack NexLM](https://www.hockeystack.com/nexlm): Nex-LM proprietary LLM for GTM automation, deal scoring, and workflow automation
- [Product | Gtm Intelligence](https://www.hockeystack.com/gtm-intelligence): GTM Intelligence product for multi-touch attribution, account scoring, and revenue analytics

## Deal Management Agents

- [Closed Lost Deal Resurrector](https://www.hockeystack.com/agents/closed-lost-deal-resurrector): AI agent for identifying and resurrecting closed lost deals with buying signals
- [Open Deal Next Best Step Generator](https://www.hockeystack.com/agents/open-deal-next-best-step-generator): AI agent providing next-best-action recommendations for open deal management
- [AE Forecast Challenger](https://www.hockeystack.com/agents/ae-forecast-challenger): AI agent challenging AE forecasts for improved forecast accuracy and pipeline analysis
- [Account Pre-Call Brief](https://www.hockeystack.com/agents/account-pre-call-brief): AI agent generating pre-call briefs for account executives from CRM and pipeline data

## Sales & Outbound Agents

- [Target Account Outbound Best Next Steps Generator](https://www.hockeystack.com/agents/target-account-outbound-best-next-steps-generator): AI agent for SDR outbound sequencing and account enrichment with intent signals
- [Sales Enablement](https://www.hockeystack.com/agents/sales-enablement): AI agent generating sales content, battle cards, and competitive intelligence
- [Weekly Rep Coaching Report](https://www.hockeystack.com/agents/weekly-rep-coaching-report): AI agent generating weekly coaching reports for sales reps and leadership
- [Win/Loss Analyzer Agent](https://www.hockeystack.com/agents/agent-win-loss-analyzer): AI agent analyzing win/loss deals for competitive intelligence and product marketing

## Revenue Operations Agents

- [Expansion Opportunity Finder](https://www.hockeystack.com/agents/expansion-opportunity-finder): AI agent identifying and scoring customer expansion opportunities and upsells
- [Customer Success Playbook Orchestrator](https://www.hockeystack.com/agents/customer-success-playbook-orchestrator): AI agent orchestrating customer success playbooks with risk detection and lifecycle management
- [Marketing Budget Optimizer](https://www.hockeystack.com/agents/marketing-budget-optimizer): AI agent for marketing budget allocation and channel benchmarking optimization
- [Multi-Touch Attribution Anomaly Detector](https://www.hockeystack.com/agents/multi-touch-attribution-anomaly-detector): AI agent for detecting anomalies in multi-touch attribution and pipeline analytics
